response: A milk delivery round begins with the driver arriving at the local farm, where the milk is collected and stored in a clean, insulated container. The driver then heads to the nearest households, delivering the milk in a timely manner. Along the way, the driver stops at community centers and schools to distribute information about healthy eating and nutrition. The round continues until all households have received their milk, ensuring that families have access to fresh, high-quality milk. P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
